column2: #camera start
Alright, boys and girls. Let's show the Bugs this is our territory.
Terran Command HQ on Kwalasha has received a distress signal from Cliffort, a remote mining settlement. The cause of their predicament is all too familiar: Arachnids.
A Mobile Infantry detachment has been dispatched to come to the miners aid. But it is located in deep canyons.
They has landed on top and must now make their way through the canyons. The detachment is led by veteran Colonel Hawthorne.
Bugs are gettin' pissed we're stepping on their territory...
Proceed! We'll show 'em this is OUR heap of sand.
We've captured all territory points. Now we just have to clear that hive.
Command has promised to provide more resources to our op as we secure this territory.
Just got reports of Spitters crawling around in these canyons. We need snipers to pick them off, pronto!
We need a Radio Operator
Good. Those turrets will protect our position while we push forward to secure more territory.
This position is quite exposed... The Bugs can hit it from two directions.
We gotta deploy defensive turrets here before we move on to the next objective.
We're gonna need more boots on the ground... Get HQ on the line and request more supplies!
More supplies have been delivered. We can now support more units.
Now that's the good stuff! Our snipers are much more efficient now.
These standard issue sniper scopes are ass! Get HQ on the line and tell them we need them to deliver the good stuff.
Bugs are heading to the evacuation site. Defend the miners!
The miners have been rescued.
Miners are hiding in the tunnel ahead. Let's get them out of here.
Damn storm has finally blown over. At least we'll be able to see Archie coming now.
We'll clear that hive and establish a new base there.
We managed to open this gate. Will provide a useful shortcut.
Take up defensive positions! Gotta be ready to deal with that counter-attack.
Archie's getting pissed. Bugs don't like us threading on their territory.
